EC2: Child unwilling to agree to second insulin injection at a meal-time
EC3: Untreated coeliac disease or other concomitant condition likely to affect BG control
EC4: Food allergies ([NOT] other than controlled Coeliac Disease)
EC5: Vegetarians, vegans or patients with religious dietary restrictions (as the standard meal contains meat)
EC6: Participant taking any glucose-containing medication concurrently
